zh.title: AirAdvisor研究：紐約拉瓜迪亞至芝加哥歐海爾為最令人緊張美國航線
zh.summary: AirAdvisor研究：紐約拉瓜迪亞至芝加哥歐海爾居首；分數不代表不安全
body: 航空乘客權利公司AirAdvisor的研究指出，在納入比較的24條美國最繁忙國內航線中，從紐約拉瓜迪亞機場（LGA）飛往芝加哥歐海爾機場（ORD）的航線，對緊張旅客而言被評為最令人緊張的航線。
該航線在AirAdvisor的「緊張旅客指數」中得分為75.8分（滿分100分）。AirAdvisor執行長Anton Radchenko強調：「高分不代表該航線不安全，而是代表旅客較可能遇到造成飛行壓力的事物，例如延誤、取消、惡劣天氣，以及在空中待更久。」
根據AirAdvisor的資料，在2025年9月至今年8月的研究期間，該航線有10.49%的航班被取消，約是研究涵蓋所有航線平均取消率3.47%的三倍。

en.title: AirAdvisor nervous flyer index: New York LaGuardia to Chicago O'Hare (ORD) tops stressful US routes
en.summary: AirAdvisor research ranks New York LaGuardia to Chicago O'Hare as most stressful US route; score not a safety indicator
body: Air passenger rights company AirAdvisor has published research identifying the most stressful US domestic flight routes for nervous flyers, using its Nervous Flyer Index.
Among the 24 busiest US domestic routes compared, the route from New York LaGuardia Airport (LGA) to Chicago O'Hare (ORD) Airport ranked as the most stressful, scoring 75.8 out of 100.

AirAdvisor CEO Anton Radchenko said: "A high score does not mean a route is unsafe. It means passengers are more likely to encounter the things that make flying stressful, such as delays, cancellations, difficult weather, and spending longer time in the air."

The index's findings include a 10.49% cancellation rate for flights on the New York LaGuardia to Chicago O'Hare route between September 2025 and August 2026, compared with a 3.47% average across all routes studied.
